title: Red tomatoes and yellow tomatoes
subtitle: A recessive allele that stops the red
subtitle_es: Un alelo recesivo que impide el rojo
objective: Fill in the Punnett squares for tomato flesh: red is dominant and yellow needs two yellow alleles.
objective_es: Rellena los cuadros de Punnett de la pulpa del tomate: el rojo es dominante y el amarillo necesita dos alelos amarillos.
description: Tomatoes are red because of lycopene. A recessive allele of one gene stops the plant making it, and the flesh stays yellow.
description_es: Los tomates son rojos por el licopeno. Un alelo recesivo de un gen impide que la planta lo fabrique y la pulpa se queda amarilla.

organism.description: A plant whose fruits ripen from green to red or yellow.
organism.description_es: Una planta cuyos frutos maduran de verde a rojo o a amarillo.

exploration.label: Colour
exploration.title: Red or yellow flesh
exploration.description: Red tomatoes make lycopene. Yellow-fleshed ones lack it because an enzyme at the start of its pathway does not work.
exploration.description_es: Los tomates rojos fabrican licopeno. Los de pulpa amarilla no lo tienen porque falla una enzima del principio de su ruta.

exploration.label: The allele
exploration.title: One working copy is enough
exploration.title_es: Con una copia que funcione basta
exploration.description: One working allele makes enough of the enzyme. Only plants with two broken alleles are yellow.
exploration.description_es: Un alelo que funcione fabrica suficiente enzima. Solo las plantas con los dos alelos rotos son amarillas.

scenarios.question: A red tomato plant (RR) is crossed with a yellow one (rr). What is the probability that a tomato is red?
scenarios.question_es: Se cruza una planta de tomate rojo (RR) con una de tomate amarillo (rr). ¿Qué probabilidad hay de que un tomate sea rojo?
scenarios.explanation: All four cells are Rr and R hides r: every tomato is red (100%).
scenarios.explanation_es: Las cuatro casillas son Rr y R oculta a r: todos los tomates son rojos (100 %).

scenarios.question: Two red plants that both carry r are crossed. What is the probability of a yellow tomato?
scenarios.question_es: Se cruzan dos plantas rojas que llevan r las dos. ¿Qué probabilidad hay de un tomate amarillo?
scenarios.explanation: Only the rr cell is yellow: 25%.
scenarios.explanation_es: Solo la casilla rr es amarilla: 25 %.

scenarios.question: A red plant that carries r is crossed with a yellow one. What is the probability of a yellow tomato?
scenarios.question_es: Se cruza una planta roja que lleva r con una amarilla. ¿Qué probabilidad hay de un tomate amarillo?
scenarios.explanation: Two cells are rr (yellow) and two are Rr (red): 50% each.
scenarios.explanation_es: Dos casillas son rr (amarillas) y dos son Rr (rojas): 50 % cada una.

hints.title: Big picture
hints.content: Fill the square first; then look at each cell: does it have at least one R?
hints.content_es: Rellena primero el cuadro; luego mira cada casilla: ¿tiene al menos una R?

hints.title: Next step
hints.content: R is dominant: RR and Rr are red. Only rr is yellow.
hints.content_es: R es dominante: RR y Rr son rojas. Solo rr es amarilla.

hints.title: Solution
hints.content: Count the cells with the colour asked about: each is worth 25%.
hints.content_es: Cuenta las casillas del color por el que preguntan: cada una vale un 25 %.

completion.title: A colour that hides
completion.summary: You saw that a yellow tomato can come from two red parents that both hide the yellow allele.
completion.summary_es: Has visto que un tomate amarillo puede salir de dos progenitores rojos que esconden los dos el alelo amarillo.
completion.realWorldImpact: Plant breeders have used the colour genes of tomatoes for more than a century to create varieties of many colours.
completion.realWorldImpact_es: Quienes mejoran plantas llevan más de un siglo usando los genes del color del tomate para crear variedades de muchos colores.

science.realWorldCase: The yellow-flesh trait of tomato was linked to the gene of phytoene synthase, an enzyme of the pathway of carotenoids, in studies of the 1990s.
science.realWorldCase_es: El rasgo de pulpa amarilla del tomate se vinculó con el gen de la fitoeno sintasa, una enzima de la ruta de los carotenoides, en estudios de los años noventa.
science.scientificContext: Phytoene synthase makes the first molecule of the carotenoid pathway. Without it, lycopene is not produced and the fruit stays yellow because of other pigments.
science.scientificContext_es: La fitoeno sintasa fabrica la primera molécula de la ruta de los carotenoides. Sin ella no se produce licopeno y el fruto queda amarillo por otros pigmentos.
gameplaySimplifications: Real tomatoes have other genes that also change colour; here only one is followed.
gameplaySimplifications_es: Los tomates reales tienen otros genes que también cambian el color; aquí solo se sigue uno.

references.title: Identification and genetic analysis of normal and mutant phytoene synthase genes of tomato by sequencing, complementation and co-suppression
